featured_reviews.name: Manoj
featured_reviews.review_text:
A truly peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience. ISKCON Juhu offers a beautiful blend of devotion, serenity, and positive energy amidst the busy city of Mumbai. The temple architecture is stunning, the deities are beautifully adorned, and the atmosphere during aarti is simply mesmerizing.
The premises are clean, well-maintained, and organized. The devotional chanting and bhajans create a calming environment that helps you disconnect from daily stress and feel spiritually refreshed. The volunteers and staff are courteous and welcoming.
Whether you are a devotee or a visitor seeking peace and cultural experience, this temple is a must-visit. The pure vegetarian prasadam and food options add to the overall experience. I left feeling blessed, relaxed, and rejuvenated. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Naincy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
A beautiful, peaceful, and well-maintained spiritual oasis located near Juhu Beach. It features a stunning marble temple dedicated to Sri Sri Radha Rasabihari, a cultural complex, a guesthouse, and a famous vegetarian restaurant. Highly recommended for spiritual seekers and tourists alike.
Pros:
Highly serene, peaceful, and positive spiritual vibe.
Extremely clean campus with good facilities (free footwear stand, clean toilets, and wheelchair accessibility).
Amazing food options, especially the pure vegetarian 'Govinda's' buffet and quick snacks at the food court.
Cons:
Gets heavily crowded during evenings, weekends, and festivals like Janmashtami.
The main temple hall closed from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM.
Finding parking nearby can be challenging during peak hours

featured_reviews.name: Jay Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
From the moment you step through the gates of ISKCON Juhu, the chaotic rush of Mumbai completely melts away. Calling this place "beautiful" would be a massive understatement, it is truly magical, deeply healing, and profoundly spiritual.
Here is why this sanctuary holds such a special place in my heart:

The Energy: The main temple hall possesses an undeniable, vibrant energy. Sitting down during the evening Aarti, surrounded by the rhythmic chanting of the Maha-Mantra and the scent of fresh flowers and incense, is a transcendent experience.

Healing Atmosphere: If you are feeling overwhelmed, stressed, or spiritually drained, this is the ultimate place to find peace. The serene marble architecture and the beautifully adorned deities of Sri Sri Radha Rasabihari exert a calming effect that instantly centers your mind. It feels like a warm embrace for a tired soul.

A Complete Spiritual Experience: Beyond prayer, the entire complex is designed to uplift you. The staff and devotees are incredibly welcoming, the bookstore is a treasure trove of wisdom, and you absolutely cannot miss the delicious Prasadam at the Govinda’s restaurant.

Tip: Try to visit during the evening Aarti. The atmosphere is electric yet peaceful, making it the perfect time for deep reflection and meditation.

Whether you are looking for a deep spiritual connection or just a quiet corner to breathe and heal, ISKCON Juhu is a divine haven in the city. I leave here feeling renewed every single time. 🙏🌸

featured_reviews.name: Aumang Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: A truly peaceful and spiritually uplifting place in the heart of Mumbai. ISKCON Juhu offers a beautiful escape from the city’s chaos, with its serene atmosphere, stunning temple architecture, and calming devotional chants. The temple is very well maintained, and the positive energy you feel here is unmatched. The darshan experience is divine, and the prasadam is wonderful. Whether you’re visiting for prayer, peace, or simply to spend some quiet time, this is a must visit place in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Pardeshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
recently visited the ISKCON Temple Juhu on a weekend during the occasion of Ram Navami, and it was truly a divine experience. The atmosphere of the temple was very peaceful and filled with positive energy.
The highlight of my visit was the “Nauka Vihar” (boat festival), which was incredibly beautiful and mesmerizing. The decoration of the deities, the lighting, and the overall arrangements were absolutely stunning and heart-touching.
The deities here are so beautiful and divine that just looking at them brings a deep sense of peace and calm.
Overall, it was a very peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience. If you are in Mumbai, this temple is a must-visit—especially during festivals, when the environment becomes even more vibrant and special.

featured_reviews.name: Priyal Desai
featured_reviews.review_text: Beautiful and peaceful temple with a very calming atmosphere. The aarti and bhajans are truly soulful, and the temple is very well maintained. The devotees and staff are welcoming, and the prasadam is delicious. It can get crowded during weekends and festivals, but the overall experience is still wonderful. A must-visit place in Mumbai for spiritual peace and positivity. ⭐⭐⭐⭐✨

featured_reviews.name: Anagh Pathak
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ISKCON Temple in Juhu, formally known as Sri Sri Radha Rasabihari Temple, is one of Mumbai’s most revered spiritual landmarks. Inaugurated in 1978, the temple was the vision of A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, who founded the Hare Krishna movement. Built on four acres of land once known as "Hare Krishna Land," the temple stands as a testament to his perseverance. The magnificent structure is crafted from white marble and features a stunning 100-foot dome, making it a "spiritual oasis" that provides a serene contrast to the relentless energy of the surrounding city.

The temple’s architecture is a masterful blend of traditional Indian design and modern functionality. Inside the main hall, visitors are greeted by intricately carved pillars and vibrant murals that depict scenes from the Mahabharata and the life of Lord Krishna. The central altars house the beautifully adorned deities of Sri Sri Radha Rasabihari, Sri Gaura Nitai, and Sri Sita Rama Laxman Hanuman. Throughout the day, the air is filled with the rhythmic chanting of the Maha Mantra and the sound of traditional instruments, creating a meditative atmosphere that draws millions of devotees and tourists each year.

Beyond its religious significance, ISKCON Juhu serves as a comprehensive cultural and educational center. The complex includes the "Heaven on Earth" wing, which features a spacious library of Vedic literature, a guesthouse, and a boutique. A highlight for many is Govinda’s, the in-house restaurant that serves delicious *sattvic* vegetarian cuisine to hundreds of guests daily. Through its various initiatives, including youth programs and Vedic education courses, the temple continues to be a vibrant hub for community service and spiritual growth, remaining a cornerstone of Mumbai's cultural fabric.

featured_reviews.name: Prathamesh Botle
featured_reviews.review_text: Sahar Sri Ayyappa Bhakta Sangham has come into existence in the year 1974, when a few Devotees of Lord Ayyappa in and around Sahar, headed by Mr M Krishnakumar, Mr KGK Nair, (Late) K Velayudhan, Mr P Radhakrishnan Nair and (Late) Karunakara Kurup (Maman), joined hands with the aim and objective of celebrating the Mandala Vilakku synchronizing with the Mandala Pooja Celebrations at Holy Sabarimala. The first Ayyappa Pooja & Bhajan was conducted at the residence of Mr K. Velayudhan in November 1974 and thereafter poojas & bhajans were conducted at the residence of various devotees during that Mandalam.
